note: The one-off setup's extractor and actions, with generic instructions ("Play the game well" and the game's own description).
instructions: Play the game well. Chrome Dino (T-Rex runner). Press Space or ArrowUp to jump, ArrowDown to duck. Avoid the obstacles. Survive as long as possible; the score grows with the distance run.

actions.description: Keep running; release all keys (also ends a jump early for a shorter hop)
Jump, or start/restart the game; holding it on following ticks makes the jump higher
Duck under low-flying birds; in the air it makes the dino drop fast
